name: dayone-mcp
description: Search and read your Day One journal with Claude. Read-only: Claude can't change anything.
long_description:
Ask Claude about your Day One journal: search, On This Day, browse and read entries.

**Read-only.** Claude can search and read your entries, but can't create, change or delete anything. Everything runs on your computer, using Day One's official CLI.

**Setup:** the one-line installer from the GitHub page installs Node.js and the Day One CLI if needed, signs you in and installs this extension.

dayone_cli_path.title: Day One CLI (optional)
dayone_cli_path.description: Leave blank to find it automatically. Only needed if dayone.exe isn't in npm's usual global folder.

tools.name: search_entries
tools.description: Search your journal by words, dates, journal, tags or starred (read-only)

tools.name: on_this_day
tools.description: Entries from this day in previous years (read-only)

tools.name: sync_journals
tools.description: Get your latest entries from Day One (read-only)
